argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$entities=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -match 'VID_0525|VID_18D1|VID_0000&PID_0002' -or $_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne 0 })
[ordered]@{time=(Get-Date).ToString('o'); devices=@($entities | Select-Object Name,PNPDeviceID,Status,ConfigManagerErrorCode); adapters=@(Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object {$_.InterfaceDescription -match 'NCM|USB'} | Select-Object Name,ifIndex,Status,InterfaceDescription,PnPDeviceID)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
